Name: All Crops All Seasons
Author: cantorsdust
Description:
[b]This mod is no longer compatible or maintained[/b]. You can use the newer [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3000]Crops Anytime Anywhere[/url] instead.



--------------



[s]Grow any crops in any season, including winter:

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cantorsdust/StardewMods/master/_archived/AllCropsAllSeasons/docs/screenshot.png[/img]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[/s][list=1]
[*][s][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/s]
[*][s]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/s]
[*][s]Run the game using SMAPI.[/s]
[/list][s]
[size=5]Use[/size]
You can now plant any crop in any season, harvest them in any season, and not lose them on season change. This mod does not change store inventories, so you can only purchase crop seeds during their usual seasons.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[/s][list]
[*][s]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 on Linux/Mac/Windows.[/s]
[*][s]Works in single-player. [b]Not recommended in multiplayer.[/b][/s]
[*][s]May conflict with some mods (including Deluxe Auto-Grabber).[/s]
[/list][s]
